summary: A 1929 steel tower in the Sierra Ancha was replaced in 1964 by the concrete-and-metal cab that still watches Pleasant Valley today.

facts.design: 10 ft concrete blockhouse with 14x14 ft CL-100 series flat-top metal cab and catwalk

access.note: Reached by the unpaved McFadden Peak Road / Forest Road 561; it is a working Forest Service facility, not a public rental.

visit.trail_note: Unpaved FR 561 to the summit; no indication the active lookout is open to climb.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Tonto National Forest, Pleasant Valley Ranger District

events.note: First lookout: 20 ft steel tower with 7x7 ft cab
1930s cabin, stock barn and shed removed; replaced by current 10 ft concrete blockhouse with 14x14 ft CL-100 flattop cab and catwalk

evidence.supports: built 1929, 1930s additions, 1964 replacement, staffed each year, NHLR registration
evidence.quote: The first lookout on McFadden Peak, located on the Pleasant Valley Ranger District of the Tonto National Forest, was a 20’ steel tower with 7’ x 7’ cab built in 1929. In the 1930s a cabin, stock barn and shed were added. These buildings were removed in 1964 when the present, 10’ concrete blockhouse with a 14’x 14’ CL-100 series flattop metal cab with catwalk, was constructed. The lookout is staffed each year.
McFadden lookout has a 14 ft. square CL-100 metal, flat roofed cab on a 10 ft. concrete block base. It was constructed in 1964.

Two benchmarks were found at McFadden. This one was placed in 1926 by the Forest Service.
The benchmark placed in 1938 has a datasheet: DU2025

evidence.supports: named for William McFadden, Sierra Ancha setting, staffed each year, FR 561 access
evidence.quote:
This peak was named after William McFadden. Why is there a road to McFadden Peak?
Set high in the Sierra Ancha, the summit hosts a lookout tower built in 1964. The lookout is staffed each year.
The old forest service road to the summit is totally unpaved. It’s called McFadden Peck Road/Forest Road (FR) 561.

sources.title: Road trip guide: Conquering the McFadden Peak
